hints.title: Highest Place Value Exchange
hints.text: To maximize the resulting number, an exchange should ideally place the largest possible digit at the highest possible significant decimal position.

hints.title: Last Occurrence Maximum Digit Invariant
hints.text: Recording the rightmost occurrence of digits zero through nine identifies the furthest instance of each digit for optimal swap placement.

hints.title: Left To Right Greedy Digit Swap Procedure
hints.text: Convert number to a list of digits. Record the last seen index for each digit from 0 to 9. Traverse digits from left to right. For each position, check if any digit greater than the current one appears at a later index. If found, perform the swap, convert back to integer, and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs of digits takes quadratic O(D^2) time, though D is at most 9 digits for 32-bit integers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the last seen position of digits 0-9 enables optimal swap detection in O(D) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain why swapping with the rightmost occurrence of the largest digit produces the maximum numerical value.
